steps.text: The lever handle starts at approximately `(0.023, 0.581, 0.25)`. Its grasp alignment puts the TCP near `(0.023, 0.526, 0.18)`; I’ll test that point and then move upward while holding the handle.

The handle moves along an arc around its hinge, so a straight upward sweep misses the needed motion. I’ll follow the handle’s arc toward the target with the gripper open, checking the lever angle after each segment.
